title: All mobs are Herobrine
description: This resourcepack makes all mobs look like Herobrine
body:
## What happened to all mobs?! 
## They are look like a Herobrine!

**Step into a world where the eyes of every creature watch you with an unblinking, pale gaze. The White Eyes Texture Pack reimagines all Minecraft mobs, replacing their original eyes with a stark, luminous white. This simple change casts a haunting spell over the entire Overworld, making even passive animals seem otherworldly and intensifying the threat of hostile foes. Explore familiar landscapes with a new sense of unease, where every turn might reveal a pair of glowing orbs staring back at you. A must‑have for fans of creepypastas and atmospheric survival.**

_- To install drop .zip archive to .minecraft/resourcepacks, then enable it in settings_
